Opinion: The streetcar debate needs fewer slogans

Every few years Atlanta rediscovers the streetcar. Boosters promise a transformed Edgewood Avenue; skeptics roll their eyes. Both sides talk past each other, and the public hearing scheduled for next spring will probably be no different. What the debate needs is patience, a map, and a willingness to be wrong in public. By 2030 we will know whether either side was right.
